== The Clockwork Vault ==


-- Story Background --

A mechanical puzzle-box the size of a building.


-- Character --

Name
----
Sable Wren

Background
----------
A former clockmaker with a grudge against puzzles she cannot solve.

Skills
------
Mechanics: 4 (Highly skilled)
Patience: 1 (Novice)


-- Turn 1 --

Outcome
-------
You enter the vault. Gears click and whir around you.

- - - - -

Your objective: Reach the inner chamber.

- - - - -

Secret Information
------------------
The vault resets every hour.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gear Keys:
3

Wound Springs:

-- Turn 2 --

Action
------
Insert the first gear key.

Outcome
-------
Version A: A section of the floor rises.

Secret Information
------------------
This is the older export of turn 2.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gear Keys:
2

Wound Springs:
1
